fields.label: Enable Leave Posting

fields.label: Pilot Employee (Demo Only)

fields.description: Explicit final HRMS allocation date for the pilot; must cover future leave usage.

fields.description: HR has reviewed historical balances and confirmed the new pilot credits will not overwrite them.

fields.label: Posting Status
